spanish: Habla a hijos de Israel, y dirás a ellos: Varón, cuando extraordinario hiciere voto, en tu valoración almas a Jehová,

findings.issue: One hiphil imperfect 3ms is split into the adjective «extraordinario» plus the unmarked verb «hiciere» (hacer). Hacer is not this lemma; the token’s single verbal action becomes “make” plus a quality.
The conjunction is fixed as temporal «cuando»; morphology only marks a conjunction, so if/that/because stay open.

notes: Other tokens match in person, number, and participants; Jehová is the licensed name.
